relations.name: olap_loans_analytics
relations.view_definition:
SELECT existing."Row ID",
    existing."Loan Date",
    existing."Close Date",
    existing."Principal Amount",
    existing."Due Date",
    existing."Ref Borrowers",
    existing."Loan Arrangement",
    existing."Loan Status",
    existing."Loan Type",
    existing."Current Daily Interest",
    existing."Fixed Interest",
    existing."Transfer Fee",
    existing."Interest Payment Interval",
    existing."Created By",
    existing."Closed By",
    existing."Defaulted",
    existing."Default Loss Amount",
    existing."Daily Payment Amount",
    existing."Auto Charge Enabled",
    existing."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
    existing."Ref Closing Payment",
    existing."Charge Generation Request",
    existing."Total Interest Received",
    existing."Total Principal Received",
    existing."Outstanding Principal",
    existing."Total Amount Received",
    existing."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
    existing."Borrower Total Interest",
    existing."Expected Interest This Month",
    existing."Effective Daily Interest Rate",
    existing."Principal Recovered by Interest %",
    existing."Principal Days MTD",
    existing."Loan Start Day Index",
    existing."Principal Start Weight",
    existing."Loan End Date",
    existing."Loan Duration",
    existing."30D Principal Days",
    existing."Loan Age Days",
    existing."Loan Age Bucket",
    existing."Defaulted Flag",
    existing."Maximum Days Late",
    existing."Last Interest Charge Date",
    existing."Accrued Interest Days",
    existing."Accrued Interest",
    existing."Daily Installment Base Principal",
    existing."Ref Disbursed From Cash Account",
    existing."Payment Request Cash Account",
    existing."Payment Request Token",
    l."Original Daily Interest Rate"
   FROM ( SELECT old_view."Row ID",
            old_view."Loan Date",
            old_view."Close Date",
            old_view."Principal Amount",
            old_view."Due Date",
            old_view."Ref Borrowers",
            old_view."Loan Arrangement",
            old_view."Loan Status",
            old_view."Loan Type",
            old_view."Current Daily Interest",
            old_view."Fixed Interest",
            old_view."Transfer Fee",
            old_view."Interest Payment Interval",
            old_view."Created By",
            old_view."Closed By",
            old_view."Defaulted",
            old_view."Default Loss Amount",
            old_view."Daily Payment Amount",
            old_view."Auto Charge Enabled",
            old_view."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
            old_view."Ref Closing Payment",
            old_view."Charge Generation Request",
            old_view."Total Interest Received",
            old_view."Total Principal Received",
            old_view."Outstanding Principal",
            old_view."Total Amount Received",
            old_view."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
            old_view."Borrower Total Interest",
            old_view."Expected Interest This Month",
            old_view."Effective Daily Interest Rate",
            old_view."Principal Recovered by Interest %",
            old_view."Principal Days MTD",
            old_view."Loan Start Day Index",
            old_view."Principal Start Weight",
            old_view."Loan End Date",
            old_view."Loan Duration",
            old_view."30D Principal Days",
            old_view."Loan Age Days",
            old_view."Loan Age Bucket",
            old_view."Defaulted Flag",
            old_view."Maximum Days Late",
            old_view."Last Interest Charge Date",
            old_view."Accrued Interest Days",
            old_view."Accrued Interest",
            old_view."Daily Installment Base Principal",
            b."Ref Disbursed From Cash Account",
            b."Payment Request Cash Account",
            b."Payment Request Token"
           FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                         SELECT q.d,
                            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
                            (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
                           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
                        ), cr AS (
                         SELECT olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans" AS id,
                            max(olap_charges_analytics."Days Late") AS late,
                            max(olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d) AS last_interest,
                            max(olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date") AS last_charge,
                            sum(olap_charges_analytics."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" > ctx.d AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.me) AS scheduled
                           FROM olap_charges_analytics
                             CROSS JOIN ctx
                          GROUP BY olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans"
                        ), br AS (
                         SELECT "Loans"."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                            sum("Loans"."Total Interest Received") AS total
                           FROM "Loans"
                          GROUP BY "Loans"."Ref Borrowers"
                        ), a AS (
                         SELECT l_1."Row ID",
                            l_1."Loan Date",
                            l_1."Close Date",
                            l_1."Principal Amount",
                            l_1."Due Date",
                            l_1."Ref Borrowers",
                            l_1."Loan Arrangement",
                            l_1."Loan Status",
                            l_1."Loan Type",
                            l_1."Current Daily Interest",
                            l_1."Fixed Interest",
                            l_1."Transfer Fee",
                            l_1."Interest Payment Interval",
                            l_1."Created By",
                            l_1."Closed By",
                            l_1."Defaulted",
                            l_1."Default Loss Amount",
                            l_1."Daily Payment Amount",
                            l_1."Auto Charge Enabled",
                            l_1."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
                            l_1."Ref Closing Payment",
                            l_1."Charge Generation Request",
                            l_1."Total Interest Received",
                            l_1."Total Principal Received",
                            l_1."Outstanding Principal",
                            l_1."Total Amount Received",
                            l_1."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
                            COALESCE(br.total, 0::numeric) AS "Borrower Total Interest",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN COALESCE(l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(l_1."Total Interest Received", 0::numeric) / l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric
                                    ELSE 0::numeric
                                END AS "Principal Recovered by Interest %",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN l_1."Loan Date" > ctx.d THEN 0::numeric
                                    ELSE COALESCE(l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) *
                                    CASE
WHEN l_1."Loan Date" >= ctx.ms AND l_1."Loan Date" <= ctx.me THEN (ctx.d - l_1."Loan Date" + 1)::numeric
ELSE EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.d)
                                    END
                                END AS "Principal Days MTD",
                            (l_1."Loan Date" - '2000-01-01'::date)::numeric AS "Loan Start Day Index",
                            l_1."Close Date" AS "Loan End Date",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN l_1."Close Date" IS NOT NULL THEN l_1."Close Date" - l_1."Loan Date" + 1
                                    ELSE NULL::integer
                                END AS "Loan Duration",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN l_1."Loan Date" > ctx.d THEN 0::numeric
                                    ELSE COALESCE(l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) * (ctx.d - GREATEST(l_1."Loan Date", ctx.d - 29) + 1)::numeric
                                END AS "30D Principal Days",
                            ctx.d - l_1."Loan Date" AS "Loan Age Days",
                            COALESCE(l_1."Defaulted", false) AS "Defaulted Flag",
                            GREATEST(0, cr.late) AS "Maximum Days Late",
                            cr.last_interest AS "Last Interest Charge Date",
                            GREATEST(0, ctx.d - COALESCE(cr.last_interest, l_1."Loan Date")) AS "Accrued Interest Days",
                            cr.last_charge,
                            COALESCE(cr.scheduled, 0::numeric) AS scheduled,
                            LEAST(l_1."Due Date", ctx.me) AS forecast_end,
                            l_1."Due Date" - l_1."Loan Date" + 1 AS term_days
                           FROM "Loans" l_1
                             CROSS JOIN ctx
                             LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.id = l_1."Row ID"
                             LEFT JOIN br ON br.id = l_1."Ref Borrowers"
                        ), b AS (
                         SELECT a."Row ID",
                            a."Loan Date",
                            a."Close Date",
                            a."Principal Amount",
                            a."Due Date",
                            a."Ref Borrowers",
                            a."Loan Arrangement",
                            a."Loan Status",
                            a."Loan Type",
                            a."Current Daily Interest",
                            a."Fixed Interest",
                            a."Transfer Fee",
                            a."Interest Payment Interval",
                            a."Created By",
                            a."Closed By",
                            a."Defaulted",
                            a."Default Loss Amount",
                            a."Daily Payment Amount",
                            a."Auto Charge Enabled",
                            a."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
                            a."Ref Closing Payment",
                            a."Charge Generation Request",
                            a."Total Interest Received",
                            a."Total Principal Received",
                            a."Outstanding Principal",
                            a."Total Amount Received",
                            a."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
                            a."Borrower Total Interest",
                            a."Principal Recovered by Interest %",
                            a."Principal Days MTD",
                            a."Loan Start Day Index",
                            a."Loan End Date",
                            a."Loan Duration",
                            a."30D Principal Days",
                            a."Loan Age Days",
                            a."Defaulted Flag",
                            a."Maximum Days Late",
                            a."Last Interest Charge Date",
                            a."Accrued Interest Days",
                            a.last_charge,
                            a.scheduled,
                            a.forecast_end,
                            a.term_days,
                            COALESCE(a."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) * a."Loan Start Day Index" AS "Principal Start Weight",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN a."Loan Age Days" <= 10 THEN '0-10 Days'::text
                                    WHEN a."Loan Age Days" <= 20 THEN '11-20 Days'::text
                                    WHEN a."Loan Age Days" <= 30 THEN '21-30 Days'::text
                                    WHEN a."Loan Age Days" <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days'::text
                                    ELSE '60+ Days'::text
                                END AS "Loan Age Bucket",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN a."Auto Charge Enabled" AND a."Loan Type" = 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN COALESCE(a."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) * a."Accrued Interest Days"::numeric
                                    ELSE 0::numeric
                                END AS "Accrued Interest",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN a."Loan Type" = 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text AND a."Loan Date" IS NOT NULL AND a."Due Date" >= a."Loan Date" THEN floor(COALESCE(a."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(a.term_days, 0)::numeric)
                                    ELSE 0::numeric
                                END AS "Daily Installment Base Principal",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN COALESCE(a."Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                                    ELSE
                                    CASE a."Loan Type"
WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN COALESCE(a."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) / a."Outstanding Principal"
WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN COALESCE(a."Fixed Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(a.term_days, 0)::numeric / a."Outstanding Principal"
WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN (COALESCE(a."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) * a.term_days::numeric - COALESCE(a."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(a.term_days, 0)::numeric / a."Outstanding Principal"
ELSE 0::numeric
                                    END
                                END AS "Effective Daily Interest Rate"
                           FROM a
                        ), final AS (
                         SELECT b_1."Row ID",
                            b_1."Loan Date",
                            b_1."Close Date",
                            b_1."Principal Amount",
                            b_1."Due Date",
                            b_1."Ref Borrowers",
                            b_1."Loan Arrangement",
                            b_1."Loan Status",
                            b_1."Loan Type",
                            b_1."Current Daily Interest",
                            b_1."Fixed Interest",
                            b_1."Transfer Fee",
                            b_1."Interest Payment Interval",
                            b_1."Created By",
                            b_1."Closed By",
                            b_1."Defaulted",
                            b_1."Default Loss Amount",
                            b_1."Daily Payment Amount",
                            b_1."Auto Charge Enabled",
                            b_1."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
                            b_1."Ref Closing Payment",
                            b_1."Charge Generation Request",
                            b_1."Total Interest Received",
                            b_1."Total Principal Received",
                            b_1."Outstanding Principal",
                            b_1."Total Amount Received",
                            b_1."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
                            b_1."Borrower Total Interest",
                            b_1."Principal Recovered by Interest %",
                            b_1."Principal Days MTD",
                            b_1."Loan Start Day Index",
                            b_1."Loan End Date",
                            b_1."Loan Duration",
                            b_1."30D Principal Days",
                            b_1."Loan Age Days",
                            b_1."Defaulted Flag",
                            b_1."Maximum Days Late",
                            b_1."Last Interest Charge Date",
                            b_1."Accrued Interest Days",
                            b_1.last_charge,
                            b_1.scheduled,
                            b_1.forecast_end,
                            b_1.term_days,
                            b_1."Principal Start Weight",
                            b_1."Loan Age Bucket",
                            b_1."Accrued Interest",
                            b_1."Daily Installment Base Principal",
                            b_1."Effective Daily Interest Rate",
                                CASE
                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text THEN 0::numeric
                                    WHEN NOT COALESCE(b_1."Auto Charge Enabled", false) OR b_1."Loan Type" = 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text AND COALESCE(b_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN b_1.scheduled
                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Type" = 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN GREATEST(0::numeric, b_1."Accrued Interest") + COALESCE(b_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric
                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Type" = 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN
                                    CASE
WHEN b_1."Due Date" > ctx.d AND b_1."Due Date" <= ctx.me THEN COALESCE(b_1."Fixed Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric)
ELSE 0::numeric
                                    END
                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Type" = 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN
                                    CASE
WHEN b_1.last_charge IS NOT NULL AND b_1.forecast_end > b_1.last_charge THEN COALESCE(b_1."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) * (b_1.forecast_end - b_1.last_charge)::numeric - (floor(COALESCE(b_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(b_1.term_days, 0)::numeric) * (b_1.forecast_end - b_1.last_charge)::numeric + GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST((b_1.forecast_end - b_1."Loan Date" + 1)::numeric, mod(COALESCE(b_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 0::numeric), NULLIF(b_1.term_days, 0)::numeric)) - (b_1.last_charge - b_1."Loan Date" + 1)::numeric))
ELSE 0::numeric
                                    END
                                    ELSE 0::numeric
                                END AS "Expected Interest This Month"
                           FROM b b_1
                             CROSS JOIN ctx
                        )
                 SELECT x."Row ID",
                    x."Loan Date",
                    x."Close Date",
                    x."Principal Amount",
                    x."Due Date",
                    x."Ref Borrowers",
                    x."Loan Arrangement",
                    x."Loan Status",
                    x."Loan Type",
                    x."Current Daily Interest",
                    x."Fixed Interest",
                    x."Transfer Fee",
                    x."Interest Payment Interval",
                    x."Created By",
                    x."Closed By",
                    x."Defaulted",
                    x."Default Loss Amount",
                    x."Daily Payment Amount",
                    x."Auto Charge Enabled",
                    x."Interest Schedule Anchor Date",
                    x."Ref Closing Payment",
                    x."Charge Generation Request",
                    x."Total Interest Received",
                    x."Total Principal Received",
                    x."Outstanding Principal",
                    x."Total Amount Received",
                    x."Expected Daily Interest Amount",
                    round(x."Borrower Total Interest", 0) AS "Borrower Total Interest",
                    round(x."Expected Interest This Month", 0) AS "Expected Interest This Month",
                    round(COALESCE(x."Effective Daily Interest Rate", 0::numeric), 4) AS "Effective Daily Interest Rate",
                    round(x."Principal Recovered by Interest %", 2) AS "Principal Recovered by Interest %",
                    x."Principal Days MTD",
                    round(x."Loan Start Day Index", 0) AS "Loan Start Day Index",
                    round(x."Principal Start Weight", 0) AS "Principal Start Weight",
                    x."Loan End Date",
                    x."Loan Duration",
                    round(x."30D Principal Days", 2) AS "30D Principal Days",
                    x."Loan Age Days",
                    x."Loan Age Bucket",
                    x."Defaulted Flag",
                    x."Maximum Days Late",
                    x."Last Interest Charge Date",
                    x."Accrued Interest Days",
                    round(x."Accrued Interest", 0) AS "Accrued Interest",
                    x."Daily Installment Base Principal"
                   FROM final x) old_view
             JOIN "Loans" b ON b."Row ID" = old_view."Row ID") existing
     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = existing."Row ID";

relations.name: reporting_forecast_inputs_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT existing.loan_id,
    existing.borrower_id,
    existing.borrower,
    existing.loan_type,
    existing.loan_status,
    existing.defaulted,
    existing.outstanding_principal,
    existing.reporting_date,
    existing.month_end,
    existing.loan || jsonb_build_object('original_rate', l."Original Daily Interest Rate") AS loan,
    existing.charges
   FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                 SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
                ), repayments AS (
                 SELECT "Repayments"."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
                    COALESCE(sum("Repayments"."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE "Repayments"."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t), 0::numeric) AS principal,
                    bool_or("Repayments"."Payment Date" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Payment Date" > ctx_1.t) AS invalid
                   FROM "Repayments"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx ctx_1
                  GROUP BY "Repayments"."Ref Loans"
                ), paid AS (
                 SELECT r_1."Ref Charges" AS charge_id,
                    sum(r_1."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r_1."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t) AS p,
                    sum(r_1."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r_1."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t) AS i,
                    bool_or(r_1."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r_1."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r_1."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR r_1."Ref Loans" IS DISTINCT FROM c_1."Ref Loans") AS invalid
                   FROM "Repayments" r_1
                     LEFT JOIN "Charges" c_1 ON c_1."Row ID" = r_1."Ref Charges"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx ctx_1
                  GROUP BY r_1."Ref Charges"
                ), charges AS (
                 SELECT c_1."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
                    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c_1."Row ID", 'date', c_1."Charge Date", 'pdue', c_1."Principal Due"::numeric, 'idue', c_1."Interest Due"::numeric, 'ppaid', COALESCE(p.p, 0::numeric), 'ipaid', COALESCE(p.i, 0::numeric), 'invalid', COALESCE(p.invalid, false) OR c_1."Charge Date" IS NULL OR c_1."Principal Due" IS NULL OR c_1."Interest Due" IS NULL)) AS charges
                   FROM "Charges" c_1
                     LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.charge_id = c_1."Row ID"
                  GROUP BY c_1."Ref Loans"
                )
         SELECT l_1."Row ID" AS loan_id,
            l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(b."Description", ''::text), b."Borrower Name", l_1."Ref Borrowers", 'Unmapped'::text) AS borrower,
                CASE l_1."Loan Type"
                    WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Interest'::text
                    WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN 'Fixed Due Date'::text
                    WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text
                    ELSE 'Unknown'::text
                END AS loan_type,
            l_1."Loan Status" AS loan_status,
            COALESCE(l_1."Defaulted", false) AS defaulted,
            l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric - COALESCE(r.principal, 0::numeric) AS outstanding_principal,
            ctx.t AS reporting_date,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, ctx.t::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS month_end,
            jsonb_build_object('status', l_1."Loan Status", 'defaulted', COALESCE(l_1."Defaulted", false), 'start', l_1."Loan Date", 'close', l_1."Close Date", 'balance', l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric - COALESCE(r.principal, 0::numeric), 'daily', l_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 'auto', l_1."Auto Charge Enabled", 'interval', l_1."Interest Payment Interval", 'anchor', l_1."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", 'type', l_1."Loan Type", 'due', l_1."Due Date", 'arrangement', l_1."Loan Arrangement", 'original', l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 'payment', l_1."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric, 'fixed', l_1."Fixed Interest"::numeric, 'invalid', l_1."Loan Date" IS NULL OR l_1."Principal Amount" IS NULL OR b."Row ID" IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.invalid, false)) AS loan,
            COALESCE(c.charges, '[]'::jsonb) AS charges
           FROM "Loans" l_1
             LEFT JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = l_1."Ref Borrowers"
             LEFT JOIN repayments r ON r.loan_id = l_1."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.loan_id = l_1."Row ID"
             CROSS JOIN ctx) existing
     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = existing.loan_id;

columns.name: Interest Schedule Anchor Date
columns.comment: Optional daily-interest schedule origin. First subsequent scheduled charge is anchor plus Interest Payment Interval. NULL uses Loan Date. Does not reset interest accrual or change existing charges.

columns.name: Ref Closing Payment
columns.comment: Payment that changed this loan from open to closed. SQL-owned; NULL for pre-migration or non-payment closure. No historical inference/backfill.

columns.name: Charge Generation Request
columns.comment: Manual generation command: Bangkok YYYY-MM-DD|unique token. Hidden and user-read-only in AppSheet; SQL derives charge components. Latest command only, not a financial ledger.

columns.name: Original Daily Interest Rate
columns.comment: Original average daily interest / original principal * 100, rounded to integer percentage points (1 means 1%). Frozen at creation. NULL means original terms unavailable.

constraints.name: Loans_Payment Request Cash Account_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("Payment Request Cash Account") REFERENCES "Cash Accounts"("Row ID") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Loans_Ref Closing Payment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("Ref Closing Payment") REFERENCES "Payments"("Row ID")

constraints.name: Loans_Ref Disbursed From Cash Account_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("Ref Disbursed From Cash Account") REFERENCES "Cash Accounts"("Row ID") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: loans_interest_schedule_anchor_date_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ("Interest Schedule Anchor Date" IS NULL OR "Loan Date" IS NOT NULL AND "Interest Schedule Anchor Date" >= "Loan Date")

routines.name: apply_principal_daily_interest
forecast_schedule_v1
routines.arguments: l jsonb, charges jsonb, t date, e date
routines.arguments_with_defaults: l jsonb, charges jsonb, t date, e date
routines.result: TABLE(due_date date, origin text, bucket text, principal numeric, interest numeric, eligible boolean, issue text)

routines.name: original_daily_interest_rate
